title: Manage automatic messages for a TikTok account
content_data:
This article walks you through the steps to manage automatic messages for a TikTok account.  

## Introduction  
Automatic messages are essential tools for creating a seamless communication experience with your audience. They help businesses greet users, answer frequently asked questions, and guide conversations effectively. 

Automatic messages include the following key features:  
- **Welcome messages**: Greet users when they first interact with your TikTok account.  
- **Suggested questions**: Provide quick answers to frequently asked questions.  
- **Chat prompts**: Encourage users to initiate conversations with interactive buttons.  
- **New follower messages**: Greet new followers and guide them towards specific actions when they follow your TikTok account.

You can use the Business Messaging API to manage these features and create a more engaging and efficient communication experience for your users.  

## Steps
- To learn about how to create a welcome message to greet users and set the tone for your communication, see [Manage the welcome message for a TikTok account](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184264385538). 
- To learn about how to configure suggested questions to address common inquiries and streamline communication, see [Manage the suggested questions for a TikTok account](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184277518338).  
- To learn about how to customize chat prompts to guide users toward specific topics or actions, see [Manage the chat prompts for a TikTok account](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184291198977).  
- To learn about how to set up a message that greets new followers and guides them toward specific actions, see [Manage the new follower message for a TikTok account](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/manage-the-new-follower-message-for-a-tiktok-account/v1.3).
